research_history_boundary.current_survivor_source_selection_bias: USDC and FDUSD are fixed because both remain live-deployable in 2026; no future price/return was used, but this is not pristine 2023 universe selection

threshold_selection_repair.selection_rule: first threshold with >=50 events, >=35% each side, <=30% maximum train-month share

mechanism.claim: aggressive BTC spot flow agreeing in the independent USDC and FDUSD quote books, while reference USDT flow remains opposite or materially weaker, diffuses into the BTCUSDT perpetual after a short delay
mechanism.action: follow the sign of the mean standardized USDC/FDUSD taker-flow imbalance
mechanism.why_distinct: the exact multi-stablecoin quote-flow panel and cross-quote consensus/USDT-lag state did not exist in prior repository alpha families
mechanism.why_not_spot_perp_absorption: SQFD uses neither spot price nor spot-perpetual price spread and requires agreement across two alternative quote books
mechanism.novelty_boundary: new intraday stablecoin-quote source axis, not a new gate archetype; FQPR uses a related quote-participation/reference-suppression shape

source_contract.available_after: exact close_time_us of each completed one-hour row
source_contract.gap_policy: missing rows allowed only before frozen activation; no fill or stale carry

causal_feature_contract.book_imbalance: signed_taker_flow_btc/base_volume_btc; valid only with positive volume and trade_count
causal_feature_contract.strict_prior_history: pandas float64 series.shift(1).rolling(window=720,min_periods=672).quantile(q,interpolation=linear) on the exact hourly grid; invalid rows stay NaN and do not count
causal_feature_contract.book_z: (current imbalance-prior q50)/((prior q75-prior q25)/1.349); zero/nonfinite scale invalid
causal_feature_contract.setup: USDC and FDUSD z signs agree and are nonzero; min absolute z >=0.75; side*USDT z <0.50; alt_share >= prior q50; false-to-true onset
causal_feature_contract.decision_time: boundary after the completed source hour
causal_feature_contract.entry: leave one complete five-minute latency bucket and enter BTCUSDT USD-M perpetual at boundary+5m open
causal_feature_contract.numeric_contract: NumPy/pandas float64, no pre-comparison rounding, literal >= and < tie handling
causal_feature_contract.historical_availability_caveat: archive close timestamps do not prove live collector finalization by boundary+5m; forward latency/parity must fail closed before live promotion

execution_contract.hold: 6 elapsed hours fixed; no stop, take-profit, or dynamic exit
execution_contract.strict_mdd: global/pre-entry HWM, entry cost, conservative funding boundary marks, every held favorable-then-adverse 5m OHLC path, virtual adverse-mark exit cost, actual exit cost
execution_contract.cagr: full declared split calendar including warm-up and idle seconds
execution_contract.reservation_order: build full-timeline onset, sort once, accept entry iff entry_time >= prior accepted exit_time with exit exclusive, then slice contained splits; independent controls reserve independently and same-clock controls reuse primary reservations
execution_contract.live_promotion: requires forward three-book finalization latency/parity audit before any order path

mechanism_controls.no_alt_breadth: alt_z=(v_USDC*z_USDC+v_FDUSD*z_FDUSD)/(v_USDC+v_FDUSD); require abs(alt_z)>=0.75; side=sign(alt_z); retain USDT lag and participation gates; independent onset/nonoverlap
mechanism_controls.extra_latency_1h: same signal and side, entry and exit delayed one hour
mechanism_controls.deterministic_random_side: same primary entries; SHA256 ASCII SQFD-6|YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ; even first hex nibble long, odd short

outcome_gate.ratio_definition: CAGR_pct/strict_MDD_pct; if MDD=0 use +inf/0/-inf by CAGR sign, and +inf controls fail the margin gate

statistical_test_contract.cluster_value: sum of net account trade returns after base costs and realized funding
statistical_test_contract.null: independent Rademacher sign per weekly sum; signed total divided by trade count; compare abs(null) >= observed - 1e-15
statistical_test_contract.exact: enumerate all 2^K vectors when nonempty weekly cluster count K <= 20; p=exceed/2^K
statistical_test_contract.monte_carlo: otherwise NumPy default_rng(20260719), 20000 draws, deterministic batches, p=(1+exceed)/(20000+1)

rejection_contract.later_failure: reject without activation, lookback, threshold, participation, lag, onset, latency, direction, hold, or support-gate repair

rllm_boundary.future_role: only after deterministic passage, an RLLM may abstain or scale down under a separately preregistered reward; it may not enter, reverse, or increase leverage

support_comparators.near_containment_definition: maximum of candidate-to-comparator and comparator-to-candidate fractions on exact common coverage
support_comparators.rank7_and_funding_premium: post-passage return correlation only; cannot select or repair SQFD because no standalone frozen clock artifact is bound here
support_comparators.interpretation: representation checks only; FQPR is included because its gate archetype is related even though its data axis and cadence differ

manifest_hash_contract: SHA256 of UTF-8 JSON excluding manifest_hash, sorted keys, separators=(comma,colon), ensure_ascii=false
